annotations.title: Ask to promote an Android release

description: Asks a person to approve moving an Android release from internal testing to production (or beta / alpha; a Wear OS, TV, Automotive or XR build on its form factor's own tracks), optionally as a staged rollout to a percentage of users. Nothing changes on Google Play until a person approves on the Ploa dashboard; this returns at once with the request's ID, so check it with ploa_approval_status. Needs a token allowed to touch production. On the App Store, an approved version is released with ploa_appstore_release, and its phased release changed with ploa_appstore_phased_release.

releaseId.description: The release ID that ploa_release_start returned.

rolloutPercent.description: Share of users for a staged rollout, 1 to 100. Default 100.

track.description: production, beta or alpha. A Wear OS, Google TV, Android Automotive or Android XR build stays on its own form factor's tracks (wear:production…) by itself; name one (wear:production) to choose.
